description: This file defines an abstract Java class for evaluating continued fractions. It provides the structure and algorithm (based on the modified Lentz method) for computing continued fractions, with abstract methods for obtaining the sequence of coefficients. It is intended to be subclassed with specific implementations providing the coefficients for particular continued fractions.

classes.name: ContinuedFraction
classes.description: Abstract class providing methods to evaluate continued fractions for subclasses that define specific coefficients.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the continued fraction at a given point x, with options for error tolerance and maximum iterations.

methods.name: getA
methods.description: Abstract method to get the n-th 'a' coefficient for a given evaluation point x.

methods.name: getB
methods.description: Abstract method to get the n-th 'b' coefficient for a given evaluation point x.
